page.layout: Running head across top; page number 14 at upper left. Main text in one column with a table of two parallel blocks at top (Itinerario Antonini left, In Tabula right), then running text, a centred inscription, and a diagram-like list of towns with braces at the bottom. One marginal note at the left margin beside the table.

page.notes: <note side="left">Milliarium numerus corruptissimus est utrobique.</note> Diagram at the bottom right is a brace group of town names, rendered as lines above; the Black letter words (Bedburg, Duiren, Zullich, Balckhusen, Wollendorff, Rip-loff, Ruit, Zulpete, Coblentz etc.) are set in black letter within roman text.
